license: Shareware; the package's own terms are the clauses below (doom19s.zip has no VENDOR.DOC or LICENSE.DOC)

license_clauses.text:
DOOM, Knee-Deep in the Dead can be freely distributed. Disk
        vendors should refer to the vendor information text file
        (vendor.doc) in your DOOM directory.

license_clauses.text:
id Software respectfully requests that you do not modify the
levels for the shareware version of DOOM.  We feel that the
distribution of new levels that work with the shareware version
of DOOM will lessen a potential user's incentive to purchase the
registered version.

If you would like to work with modified levels of DOOM, we
encourage you to purchase the registered version of the game.

license_clauses.source: John Carmack (id Software), e-mail of 1999-10-23 quoted in Debian doom-wad-shareware debian/copyright

The DOOM shareware wad is freely distributable.  No Quake data is freely
distributable.

license_clauses.source: DMFAQ66A.TXT (DOOM FAQ, excluded from the disk)

bundling: No bundling condition in the package; the ENDOOM text sends disk vendors to a vendor.doc that doom19s.zip does not contain. CiukiOS charges nothing.
source_code: GPL-2.0 (https://github.com/id-Software/DOOM, linuxdoom-1.10). The bundled DOOM.EXE is id's original 1.9 binary, not rebuilt.
game_data: Shareware episode 1 (DOOM1.WAD) only. The registered DOOM.WAD is the owner's local copy (third_party/Doom), never bundled.
modifications: none: the archive is vendored unmodified; scripts/build_games_disk.py installs its members byte-identical into \DOOM, except the four FAQ files
